question: Can a tenant-scoped published LMS course run the fixed Titan structural research lab and attach exact canonical evidence to pending independent review, with replay and course-version identity preserved?

baseline.observation: Existing Titan-Hermes evidence-flow test failed because executor tool_identity was absent. The legacy fixture also lacked current signed-verifier trust bindings.

scope: Merlin Learning university LMS + Titan generic envelope/protocol structural research; code and synthetic fixtures only
premises: Trusted application layer supplies Actor and distinct tenant/project provisioning.
Published course manifests are immutable; current version can change between calls.
Titan model/vector fixtures do not implement cryptographic primitives or demonstrate security.
Registry bytes and graph evidence do not award learner mastery.

predictions.acceptance: Known fixed lab produces exact model/vector ArtifactRef and source-bound course receipt; repeated identical run remains one version/evidence.
Wrong tenant/learner/role/manifest, changed evidence, conflicting run identity and stale course submissions fail without automatic grading.
Current and replayed assessments check expected version/hash inside their write transaction.
Concurrent identical canonical producers both succeed; metadata conflicts remain rejected.

Synthetic end-to-end course, frozen transcript, lab, review queue and recommendation run and replay on real canonical SQLite/blob/graph stores; no network/keys/plaintext/ciphertext operations or real student data.

simplex.reason: No convex mixing is needed for exact artifact/course binding.
simplex.test: Boolean identity checks cannot be traded off by weights.

n_ality.reason: Tenant, learner, course/version, artifact identity and protocol state remain independent axes.
n_ality.test: No one axis substitutes for another.

continuum.reason: This slice uses discrete identities and state transitions.
continuum.test: No interpolation between acceptance and rejection.

fuzzy_logic.reason: Future formative category membership needs separately validated semantics; review, permission and integrity stay Boolean.
fuzzy_logic.test: No score or membership awards mastery or verification.

stopping_and_iteration: Local focused tests and independent source review first, then one pinned unprivileged OCI integration run. Diagnose observed failures before a changed-source retry. Retain null/failure evidence.
limits: Known software fixture, not new-data research confirmation or educational efficacy.
Synthetic publication review is not a real faculty approval.
No direct institutional SSO/LTI production deployment or independent Titan cryptographic qualification.
No changes to the running private service, production registry or shared-runner grants for this validation.
